regime.label: MODEST RISK-OFF OPEN INSIDE AN INTACT UPTREND -- AND, FOR THE FIRST TIME IN FIVE SESSIONS, VOL IS BIDDING
evidence: SPY 766.15 (-0.38% vs 769.06 close), QQQ 712.89 (-0.45% vs 716.08). Broad but shallow; this is a drift lower, not a break.

Leadership is SPLIT, not uniformly red: AVGO 364.95 (+0.68%) and AMD 468.27 (+0.40%) are green while TSLA 345.42 (-1.62%), MSFT 482.00 (-0.48%) and TSM 411.67 (-0.10%) are red. NVDA 217.54 is dead flat (-0.01%) five sessions before its print.

THE CHANGE THAT MATTERS: 30-day ATM IV rose on 8 of 9 tracked names versus yesterday (only AMD flat/lower). SPY 0.1276->0.1315, QQQ 0.1966->0.2027, NVDA 0.3920->0.4032, MSFT 0.2539->0.2608, TSLA 0.4035->0.4131, RBRK 0.7617->0.7788. VIX 15.87 vs 15.28. The four-session 'vol will not bid' regime has stopped.

TREND STRUCTURE INTACT BUT QQQ IS AT AN INFLECTION: QQQ 712.89 sits +0.86% above its 20d (706.78) and DEAD ON its 50d (712.98, -0.01%). SPY 766.15 is +0.84% over its 20d (759.77) and +2.09% over its 50d (750.43). QQQ is the weaker index and it is standing on a line.

MACRO: Wednesday's July FOMC minutes were hawkish -- a 9-3 hold with three regional presidents dissenting FOR a hike and NO discussion of a cut, citing AI-driven inflation risk. Offsetting that, Treasury surprised by more than doubling buybacks of 10/20/30-year debt, pulling yields down and lifting crypto. Trump separately vowed to squeeze Iran economically.
regime.implication: The two-sided vol non-participation that justified standing flat all week has just weakened, which is genuinely new information -- but it is a single opening print and opening IV is systematically inflated by wide auction markets. The correct response is to WATCH whether it holds into the afternoon, not to buy premium on the tick. Separately, the desk is already positioned for the bearish case (two puts plus the hedge) and the bearish-tech theme is at its 2-of-2 cap, so the only thing rising vol changes today is the value of what is already owned.
